name: Access Charity Website
shortDescription: A UK charity website and fundraising suite with donation, event, shop and Gift Aid capabilities; it is a general charity product rather than church-specific software.
suitableContexts: Larger church charities needing a fundraising-focused website
Churches running donation appeals, events or an online shop
Organisations needing a supplier-led charity web platform rather than a simple church-site builder

pricing.summary: A current UK Government Digital Marketplace listing shows Access Charity Website pricing from £953 per year for a website-suite instance. Confirm the current scope, implementation costs, VAT and contract term directly with Access.
pricing.trialDetails: No public trial route was identified in reviewed material.

gdprInformation: Access publishes a group privacy notice. Its current product data-processing agreement, hosting region, sub-processors, retention, export and deletion arrangements should be obtained for the precise charity website and fundraising modules being procured.
importExport: Supplier describes an API; confirm available data export routes and scope in the current contract.
support: Digital Marketplace listing describes a 99.70% monthly availability target for the service

uk-operator.value: Companies House records Access UK Ltd (02343760).

product-scope.value: The UK Government Digital Marketplace listing describes a charity website suite with fundraising, donations, Gift Aid, events, shop and API capabilities.

pricing.value: The listing publishes pricing from £953 per year for a website-suite instance.

editorial.assessment: Access Charity Website is a broad UK charity platform, not a church-management system or a low-cost church-site builder. It can be relevant to a larger church charity with substantial fundraising, campaign, event or shop needs, but a church should assess implementation effort and the precise contracted modules before comparing its published starting price with simpler church products.
bestFor: Larger church charities with fundraising and campaign requirements
Organisations wanting website, donation and event workflows from one charity-sector supplier
strengths: UK supplier and published government-marketplace product record
Fundraising, events, shop and Gift Aid capabilities are described
Published starting price and supplier availability target
limitations: General charity product, not tailored specifically to church administration
Current public material does not establish the exact package or implementation cost a church will need
Churches should obtain current processing, hosting, export and exit evidence for their chosen modules
